about: OpenCV's sample clip vtest.avi (opencv/samples/data): a busy plaza seen from above, 768x576 at 10 frames a second, 79.5 s. Not a society camera; the same scene the Plaza demo camera plays.
labelled_by: us (the Pehra team), by eye from frames of the clip, on 26 Oct 2026. One labeller, no second check. Times are to about half a second.
rules: enter: a person's feet come into the left walkway zone from outside it (across its right or top edge, or walking in from the left or bottom edge of the picture). cross_in and cross_out: a person's feet cross the walkway edge line (x = 0.5, from y = 0.3 down to the bottom) going left (in, onto the walkway side) or right (out). People already inside when the clip starts are not entries; the first skip_start_s seconds are not scored.
